d:
Har taraph lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ki raunak hai. desh duniya men rahne vale bihar ke log apne ghar pahunchkar paranpraon aur manyataon ke sath chhath ki taiyari men lage hain. puri aastha shuddhata pavitrata se chhath vrittiyon ke gharon men kharna ki bhi taiyariyan chal rahi hain. gramin kshetron men sadiyon purani paranpraon ko aaj bhi jivit rakha jata hai.
